Disclosure — talks only to the self-hosted Vornik daemon at VORNIK_URL with VORNIK_BROKER_TOKEN (and VORNIK_MEMORY_TOKEN for memory); broker tools let the agent start operator-approved workflows on that daemon (writes are approved by a person in Vornik); when selected as memory provider it sends each turn's user query for recall, mirrors MEMORY.md and USER.md writes to the daemon, and asks the daemon to stop recalling (not delete) a mirrored entry that Hermes removes or replaces (/vornik-memory lists and /vornik-forget forgets what Vornik keeps); artifact tools expose only named outputs allowed by the approved workflow from completed runs and read bounded text or return short-lived binary download links from the daemon; task diagnosis tools (offered only when the daemon advertises companion-progress) return a broker task's execution events and closed error classes as the daemon serves them to a broker key; hermes vornik approvals on writes security.approval.transport (and vornik_companion.approval_namespace) to Hermes config, after which Hermes's own dangerous-command prompts (the redacted command text) are sent through the local vornikctl agent host-approval to the daemon and answered on the paired phone, any failure or a Vornik outage denying the command unless transport_fallback: builtin is set, and the plugin never decides itself; hermes vornik connect runs the local vornikctl, which adds an MCP entry to Hermes config.

entries.name: wait-ledger
entries.description: Local ledger of the times Hermes stopped to wait for you (approval prompts, clarify questions, password prompts): /waits shows how many waits there were, how many were answered or left unanswered, and how long Hermes stood still in total, typically and at most, per kind of prompt, per platform or per day, for the last 24 hours, any number of hours or days, the latest session or everything recorded; /waits recent lists the newest waits (ten, or up to 100 with /waits recent 50). Disclosure — writes wait metadata (session id, platform, kind of prompt, how it ended, wait time; no prompt text, answer or session key) to plugin-data/wait-ledger/waits.jsonl, trimmed to 5,000 rows past 2 MB; observer only, cannot answer, delay or change a prompt; no network

entries.name: wakeshift
entries.title: Wakeshift
entries.description: Wakes your Hermes chats when Wakeshift-enabled MCP servers you've added have news for them: a price drop, a finished build or a reply starts a new turn in the chat that asked for it, even while it's idle, framed as outside information rather than as you. Works for API server (gateway) and CLI chats. Disclosure — contacts only the Wakeshift servers it trusts (https://app.wakeshift.ai unless you set plugins.entries.wakeshift.settings.issuers): fetches their signing keys, exchanges signed beacons from MCP tool results for each chat's stream link, holds those streams open in background threads while Hermes runs, and acknowledges delivered messages; no telemetry. Starts runs on Hermes's own API server at 127.0.0.1 with the API server's key (read through agent.secret_scope). Fills in the harness argument (hermes), and the chat's own session_key when the model omits it, on calls to Wakeshift-enabled tools. It starts no turn in any chat (API server or CLI) until the user turns on plugins.entries.wakeshift.allow_gateway_injection: true; until then it tells the chat the command, and holds messages until it is on. Removes Wakeshift beacons from MCP tool results and adds a one-line note. Stores each connected chat's stream links and session keys, one per server (which include access tokens), cached signing keys and delivery state under $HERMES_HOME/wakeshift (files 0600). Never answers approvals and runs no shell commands. Wakeshift's Connector Terms (https://wakeshift.ai/connector-terms) and Privacy Policy (https://wakeshift.ai/privacy) apply.

entries.name: walkie-talkie
entries.title: Walkie-Talkie
entries.description: Let one session message another existing session (Telegram topic, group thread or DM), waking it like a user turn so the reply lands in that chat Disclosure — starts agent turns in other existing gateway sessions (any routed chat, including groups, and from cron jobs) via ctx.inject_message, only after plugins.entries.walkie-talkie.allow_gateway_injection: true; after an accepted handoff it posts a visible copy into the target chat through Hermes's send_message helper using your existing gateway bot credentials; reads state.db, config.yaml and cron/jobs.json read-only; no network calls of its own, no shell, no telemetry.

entries.name: wallaby-provider
entries.description: Wallaby Token — curated open-weight inference (Kimi K3, K3.1 Pro); adds Wallaby to the hermes model provider list.

entries.name: wallpaper-theme
entries.title: Wallpaper Theme
entries.description: A Hermes Desktop theme that follows your wallpaper. Reads Pywal's ~/.cache/wal/colors.json by default, or any palette JSON you point it at (settings page or ~/.config/hermes-wallpaper-theme/config.json), derives a palette with checked contrast floors and repaints live when the file changes. Optional glass mode paints a translucent background for native window materials or compositor blur. Disclosure — the desktop half uses only @hermes/plugin-sdk; the palette file is read by the package's own backend route (dashboard/plugin_api.py, GET /api/plugins/wallpaper-theme/palette, mounted once the plugin is in plugins.enabled), polled every 3 seconds with a change stamp. That route reads only JSON files inside the user's home directory (or XDG_*_HOME) under 256 KiB and returns colour fields only, never raw file text. No network calls, no shell commands, no credentials, no telemetry.

entries.name: watchline
entries.description: Watchline delivery adapter for Hermes Agent. Polls a Watchline pull channel and forwards matched events into the Hermes gateway as inbound messages.

entries.name: waypoint
entries.description: Session status for Hermes Desktop: a thin bar next to every sidebar session with four states — Working (remembers your next step), Waiting on someone (who/what plus a follow-up reminder), Done (outcome plus a fresh-start handoff) and untracked. Suggests 3 next steps per session (instant quick ideas from the chat, opt-in AI ideas from the auxiliary model, priority colours) with one-click Ask, a Power up button that asks a strong model for sharper ideas on demand, and Mark complete to stop suggestions. Adds a Status Board page (columns, follow-ups due, stale sessions, archive all done), triage of untracked sessions, a resume banner above the composer, a status-bar counter, a daily summary, palette commands and English/Arabic (RTL). SDK-only: session-row slots, a route, sidebar nav, status bar, composer banner, palette. Disclosure — no network calls of its own (all model calls go through Hermes llm.oneshot); AI next-step suggestions are OFF by default; when enabled, after new replies (at most every 90 s) the plugin sends the focused session's last ~12 user/assistant messages (≤ ~7,000 chars) plus its title and the user's notes to the auxiliary task title_generation (Hermes default "auto" = your main model); Power up runs only when pressed — also with AI suggestions off — and sends a longer excerpt (last ~20 messages, ≤ ~12,000 chars) to the plugin's own auxiliary tasks waypoint_ideas / waypoint_ideas_2 (registered by __init__.py; unset they resolve to "auto" = your main model) or, for "My chat model", to the open session's model; an optional automatic big idea (off by default) uses the same choice at most every 10 minutes; Power up call log (2.5.0): the Python half also registers two observe-only hooks (pre_auxiliary_call, post_auxiliary_call) that ignore every auxiliary task except waypoint_ideas / waypoint_ideas_2 and, for those, write one line per call to the user's own Hermes log (logs/agent.log) and append a record to <HERMES_HOME>/plugin-data/waypoint/power-calls.jsonl (rolls over at ~1 MB): model, provider, reasoning effort, response time, token counts (logged as 'unknown' with a reason when Hermes reports none), finish reason and status — never prompt, message or reply text, nothing leaves the machine, and the hooks never modify a call; reads session history (session.history) and titles (session.list); statuses, notes and cached suggestion text are kept in desktop plugin storage; archives sessions only when you press Archive (undo offered) or confirm "Archive N done" on the board (no undo; sessions stay under Archived); posts in-app and native OS notifications for due reminders and a once-a-day local summary; writes composer drafts only on Ask / Insert / Start fresh session and never sends them.

entries.name: weather
entries.description: Weather data, radar/model imagery, and verified meteorological calculations. Built on metrust, rusbie, wrf-rust, rustdar, and ecape-rs.

entries.name: web-crawler-spider
entries.title: Web Crawler Spider
entries.description: A small spider that lives on the Hermes Desktop window: a web that grows with tool calls, helper spiders for subagents, an amber mood while Hermes waits for approval, spider-sense for risky commands, flies, napping. By default it roams only its own overlay and reads nothing from the app; walking between the app's real buttons and links is an opt-in setting (off by default). Desktop-only (desktop/plugin.js inside the plugin SDK surface); no agent tools, hooks, middleware or env vars. Disclosure — draws an animated overlay on the Desktop window and reads gateway events (tool runs, subagents, approval waits, risky-command flags) and the app's theme colours; the opt-in "Explore the app" setting (off by default) also scans the window's buttons, links and alert banners, including button labels, to walk to them.

entries.name: web-deepseek
entries.description: DeepSeek Search + Fetch — routes web_search and web_extract through DeepSeek's in-house AI search engine and server-side fetcher on api.deepseek.com (opened up in the vendor's 2026-10-17 changelog: AI-native engine indexing hundreds of billions of pages, multilingual, filters SEO spam / GEO manipulation / low-quality AIGC). Registers the provider id `deepseek-web`. Disclosure — each search/fetch is a separate billed DeepSeek call at $0.75 per 1,000 successful requests per endpoint, and only HTTP 200 responses that produce a result are billable (5 QPS per account per endpoint, plus a per-domain QPS limit on fetch); the provider reuses DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and sends it only to api.deepseek.com; extract returns Markdown only (no HTML variant, so web_extract(format="html") gets Markdown), and anti-bot or JS-rendered sites fail (zhihu.com, x.com, nytimes.com returned HTTP 404 in testing) while static pages work.

entries.name: web-defuddle
entries.description: Defuddle content extraction — local, free, no API key. Shells out to the defuddle CLI for clean article markdown. Extract-only; pair with SearXNG or another search provider.

entries.name: web-local
entries.description: Keyless local web extract: fetches pages from this machine with httpx and reduces them to readable text with trafilatura. No API key, no third-party service. Extract-only; pair with any search provider.

entries.name: web-meta-ai
entries.description: Meta web search — routes web_search through the server-side web_search tool on Meta's Responses API (Muse Spark); search-only. Disclosure — each search is a separate billed Meta Model API call (per-query web search fee plus tokens) on MODEL_API_KEY.

entries.name: web-octen
entries.description: Octen web search with query-focused highlights and page extraction.

entries.name: web-ollama-cloud
entries.description: Ollama Cloud web search + content extraction via Ollama's native REST API. Search returns web results; extract fetches page content. Reuses OLLAMA_API_KEY (https://ollama.com/settings/keys).

entries.name: web-oxylabs
entries.description: Oxylabs AI Studio web search and extraction provider for Hermes Agent. Requires OXYLABS_API_KEY (sign up at https://aistudio.oxylabs.io/api-key).

entries.name: web-search-plus
entries.description: Multi-provider web search, URL extraction, quality reports, and opt-in research mode. Disclosure — reads the operator's HERMES_HOME/config.yaml (read-only) for its own Desktop settings block (country, language, max_results, auto_routing, provider_order, searxng_url, donsetch_bin) and, in its status command, the web backend and keyless_rescue settings, and checks (without opening it) whether a pre-5.1 .env file exists in its plugin folder or HERMES_HOME/plugins, to tell upgraders where their keys went; only when the operator opts in (serper.resolve_redirects, off by default) it sends one GET per Google /goto result link to google.com to resolve it; may spawn an operator-configured local donsetch CLI as a subprocess (argv, no shell).

entries.name: web-serply
entries.description: Serply web search provider for Hermes Agent. Google web results via the Serply SERP API. Requires SERPLY_API_KEY (sign up at https://serply.io).

entries.name: web-toon
entries.description: Paid web extract over TOON: web_extract pays a TOON node about $0.001 per page from a local payer sidecar; the node fetches through an Anyone network exit and returns markdown with a wuzzy/crawl v1 content hash. Disclosure — with TOON_PAYER_URL set and web.extract_backend toon, every web_extract URL goes to the user's anonfetch payer sidecar and spends about $0.001 from its TOON payment channel with no per-call confirmation; the sidecar's daily cap and origin allowlist are the only spending controls; pages are fetched through Anyone network exits.

entries.name: web-venice
entries.description: Venice AI web search + extract — privacy-first, zero data retention, $0.01/request.

entries.name: webly
entries.title: Webly
entries.description: Publish a website, or share files and folders, at a live *.webly.site URL from Hermes Agent with no account, then sign in to claim it, edit it, and publish drafts the person approves through the hosted Webly MCP server (Streamable HTTP). Portable Agent Plugins v1 package (plugin.json + mcp.json + skills/). Disclosure — MCP tool calls go to api.webly.ai/v1/mcp, sending WEBLY_API_KEY as a bearer header when it is set, and the webly server is marked untrusted so Hermes asks before each Webly MCP tool that changes something. The bundled webly skill runs a local Node.js 20+ helper (scripts/webly.mjs) through the shell: it uploads only the files and folders the person asks to publish or share to api.webly.ai (sites are public unless password-protected), runs the project's npm/pnpm/yarn install and build first when the folder has a build script, opens the browser for sign-in and claim, and keeps its anonymous-site token and optional OAuth sign-in in ~/.webly (mode 0600). Its doctor command reads ~/.claude.json, ~/.claude/settings.json and ~/.codex/config.toml only to see whether a webly MCP server is configured there. Publishing, deleting and replacing sites through that helper are gated by skill instructions, not by Hermes approvals. The catalog copy has no update check.

entries.name: webmint
entries.title: webmint
entries.description: Turn a website into a deterministic tool: a real browser captures the page once, the host's own model writes a declarative extraction spec, two runs must agree (same field set, >=50% fill per field) before it is saved, and every later call runs that spec with no model in the loop (~2.7s). Five tools: setup, mint, run, list, remove. Disclosure — needs Node >= 18 and Playwright; on first mint the plugin installs Playwright and Chromium into its own directory (~120 MB, opt out with WEBMINT_NO_AUTO_SETUP=1). Capture runs in a fresh signed-out browser: actions may fill, click and submit forms, and http specs replay the captured GET or POST (Cookie and Authorization headers are never replayed). Public http(s) URLs only — file:, loopback/private and link-local/metadata addresses are refused, with private/loopback behind WEBMINT_ALLOW_PRIVATE_URLS=1 or the host's security.allow_private_urls. Headless Chromium is refused by some bot-protected sites.

entries.name: wechat-social-assistant
entries.description: Local-first WeChat relationship memory assistant for macOS: captures only what is visible in the WeChat window via system OCR/Accessibility, stores everything in a local SQLite database (0600/0700 permissions, no cloud), and serves contact briefs, follow-up planning, outreach drafts and weekly relationship reports through 32 MCP tools. Engine pinned to the immutable PyPI release wechat-social-assistant==1.5.1 over uvx stdio; Portable Agent Plugins v1 package (mcp.json + skills/), needs uv on PATH. All data confined to PLUGIN_DATA via WSA_ALLOWED_ROOT + path enforcement. Never reads WeChat databases, never injects into WeChat, never sends messages — outreach is drafts for human review only. Disclosure — reads WeChat only by screenshotting/OCR-ing and walking the macOS Accessibility tree of the frontmost window (not WeChat's databases or a bot API), compiles bundled Swift helpers with swiftc into ~/Library/Caches/wechat-social-assistant/bin on first use, and needs Screen Recording (optionally Accessibility) permission for the host terminal; no network egress, never sends messages.

entries.name: whatsapp-agent-platform
entries.title: WhatsApp Agent Platform
entries.description: Community platform plugin (not affiliated with Meta or Nous Research) connecting a WhatsApp Agent to Hermes through Meta's WhatsApp Agent Platform API (/agent/v1): long-poll inbound (no public URL), text and media. Disclosure — sends the API key and message content, files included, only to Meta: api.whatsapp.com, plus lookaside.fbsbx.com for downloads (per WhatsApp's Third-Party Agents Terms, agent chats are not end-to-end encrypted); stores the poll cursor, recent message ids and the creator's id under HERMES_HOME; no other network egress, no telemetry, no self-update. Exception: Hermes fetches image URLs in replies (SSRF-guarded, no key), revealing the server's IP to that host. Files go only to the creator; Meta keeps uploads up to 30 days. Received files are cached under HERMES_HOME (deleted after ~24 h while the gateway runs) and may reach the configured model, vision or speech-to-text provider. WHATSAPP_AGENT_PLATFORM_MEDIA_ENABLED=false disables media. By default only the agent's creator (verified through Meta's API) can message Hermes; WHATSAPP_AGENT_PLATFORM_ALLOWED_USERS or WHATSAPP_AGENT_PLATFORM_ALLOW_ALL_USERS widens that explicitly. The agent API key is saved to the Hermes .env; the state file under HERMES_HOME is 0600 and never contains the key.

entries.name: wheelspin
entries.title: WheelSpin
entries.description: Spin a real wheel: any list becomes a weighted, animated Desktop wheel that lands on an answer in chat, with hidden jackpots and a slot-machine reveal. Disclosure — by default each Desktop spin posts "The wheel says: <winner>" into the active chat as a user message, which starts a model turn (toggle in the pane); stores wheels and spin history in plugin-data/wheelspin/.

entries.name: wicked-memory
entries.description: Persistent, wallet-scoped long-term memory for Hermes: remember, semantic recall, versioned update, history and approved hard delete, backed by the hosted Wicked Memory service, plus skills for using it and for connecting the Wicked MCP server. Works with no setup (a wallet is generated on first use; search uses the service's shared free key). Disclosure — sends the memory text and search queries the agent chooses to memory.wickedapi.com (or your configured base_url), each request signed by the agent's wallet, plus one GET to /v1/status on first use to read the published community key; stores a generated private key unencrypted in the plugin data dir unless you supply WICKED_MEMORY_PRIVATE_KEY; no shell commands, no background processes, no telemetry; every wicked_memory_forget asks for human approval. The bundled wicked-suite-mcp skill walks you through adding the author's hosted Wicked MCP server (https://mcp.wickedapi.com/mcp, 75 tools, some x402-priced); that server is a separate manual step and is not covered by this pin.

entries.name: wiki-ref
entries.description: @wiki:<title> context references: attach the lead section of a Wikipedia article to a message, or one section with @wiki:<title>#<section>, with title autocomplete in the TUI and Desktop composer. Disclosure — sends HTTPS GET requests to <language>.wikipedia.org/w/api.php only (the referenced title and the typed autocomplete prefix leave the machine; a section is cut locally); no API key, no files written, no subprocess; register() only adds the @wiki: reference provider.

entries.name: wireguard
entries.title: WireGuard
entries.description: Read-only status and peer list for a WireGuard server running on the same Windows machine as Hermes. Two tools: vpn_status (service state, tunnel address and port, server public key, per-peer handshake and transfer) and vpn_peers (the peer list only). The plugin runs only wg.exe show, sc.exe query, and one PowerShell adapter lookup; it never changes the tunnel and never reads the tunnel configuration file or any private key material. Windows only (WireGuard for Windows). Disclosure — runs local wg.exe show, sc.exe query and one PowerShell Get-NetIPAddress lookup (read-only, never touches the tunnel config or private key); tool results put peer public keys, allowed IPs and peer endpoint IP addresses into the conversation sent to your model provider.

entries.name: withhuman
entries.title: withHuman
entries.description: Human approval for Hermes tool calls, with human in the loop guardrails. Set rules for what runs automatically, and send the rest to your team to approve or deny from Slack, Discord or your phone. Keep an audit log of every call. Disclosure — every tool call's name and arguments are sent to your withHuman organization (app.withhuman.ai or the address you configure) and run only after approval. The plugin downloads a pinned, checksum-verified withHuman CLI from downloads.withhuman.ai and runs it once per tool call. Setup offers to set the profile-wide `plugins.hook_callback_timeout` to 0, which removes Hermes's hook hang guard for every plugin. On hosted withHuman, setup adds the `withhuman-gateway` MCP server, which sends your agent key to your withHuman address, and offers to install the withHuman skills from withhuman.ai.

entries.name: wolfmarkdown
entries.title: WolfMarkDown
entries.description: Create, clean, and verify standalone Markdown with conservative semantic repair and deterministic artifact checks. Disclosure — skill-only plugin that has the agent run its bundled Node.js 22+ scripts through the terminal; on first use it runs `npm ci` in the plugin folder (lockfile-pinned packages from registry.npmjs.org), and the optional `/wolfmarkdown setup` also creates skill symlinks in ~/.agents/skills and ~/.claude/skills.

entries.name: woof
entries.description: Plan, launch, watch and compare WOOF weather simulations on your own NVIDIA GPU: size runs with WOOF's own planner, launch them locally or on an ssh/WSL GPU host, get maps in the chat while the forecast runs, compare physics or resolution, run multi-arm research campaigns and score runs against radar and surface observations. Disclosure — runs need Linux x86_64 with an NVIDIA GPU (plan-only elsewhere); the user-run hermes woof install pip-installs recast-woof>=1.0.0,<1.1 into ~/woof-env and downloads WOOF tables and optional geography (about 1.6 GB); runs execute the WOOF CLI as detached background jobs writing to ~/woof-runs and fetch public weather data; run events are pushed into the chat as user-role messages; the optional serve/ scripts download llama.cpp and a Qwen GGUF and start an unauthenticated local model server.

entries.name: word-peek
entries.title: Word Peek
entries.description: Explore HTML passages in a folder-granted reader, ask Hermes in the passage's captured chat, and save notes or whole-document edits with verified backups and Undo. Web selections use the consent-based preview SDK and are read-only. Chat answers are matched to their submitted turn. Selected text, context, references and whole-edit documents go through the configured Hermes agent and its tools. Reads and writes use the Desktop file SDK; edited documents and exclusive .word-peek-*.bak copies stay in the granted folder. Glossary and recovery metadata use plugin storage. No agent tools, hooks, middleware, credentials, telemetry or direct model API calls are added.

entries.name: workflow-record
entries.description: hermes record: demonstrate a browser workflow once (clicks, field values, navigations) and its bundled skill lets /learn turn the recording into a skill that replays it with the browser tools. A Hermes Labs plugin: built by Nous Research, not supported. Disclosure — attaches over CDP to a Chromium you point it at (--cdp, BROWSER_CDP_URL, browser.cdp_url or 127.0.0.1:9222) and records what you do in that tab until Ctrl-C; password, one-time-code and card fields are masked inside the page as {SECRET:name} and never written. Recordings stay local in <HERMES_HOME>/recordings; nothing is sent anywhere until you run /learn on one, which hands it to your active model.

entries.name: world-clock
entries.title: World Clock
entries.description: One time zone in your Hermes Desktop status bar, every other zone you work with a click away. Click the time for a drop-up of your enabled zones; Edit zones lists standard IANA zones with live UTC offsets. Desktop-only (desktop/plugin.js inside the plugin SDK surface); no network, agent tools, hooks, middleware or env vars.

entries.name: writing-guard
entries.description: Style check for every Hermes answer in German and English: finds em and en dashes outside code, links and quotes (optionally replaces them by rule: ranges and list bullets become hyphens, dashes between words a comma), reports stock AI phrases (German and English) and mixed or switched forms of address (du/Sie) in German. Reports by default with one line appended to the answer; rule based, no model calls. Disclosure — no network calls and no model calls. A transform_llm_output hook reads the final answer of each turn; in report mode it appends one report line when there is a finding, in fix mode it also replaces dashes, with footer: false it never changes the answer; the returned text is what Hermes stores and shows. Stores per chat session id only the last form of address (du or sie) and a timestamp in HERMES_HOME/plugin-data/writing-guard/sessions.json (30 days, at most 2000 sessions); the last report with matched phrases stays in process memory only. Reads only its own plugin settings. Off on cron, subagent, kanban, batch and webhook by default. Registers the tool writing_guard_check (checks a draft, returns JSON), the slash command /writing-guard (settings, last report, check a text) and a skill that adds one line to the skills index of every session while the plugin is enabled.

entries.name: wyoming-voice-bridge
entries.description: Wyoming speech-to-text and text-to-speech for a Wyoming server you run (stt/tts provider `wyoming`), plus a wyoming_voice_status tool that lists the server's models and voices. Disclosure — Audio and text to speak go to the WYOMING_* host:port you set over cleartext, unauthenticated TCP (public addresses accepted). Once selected, the providers send speech in every session, including cron and webhooks. This build imports the installed package only when its file tree is the official wyoming 1.5.4 wheel, and a different tree sends nothing. This build lists no ffmpeg digest, so audio that is not already 16 kHz, 16-bit, mono WAV is not converted. wyoming_voice_status asks with one public pre_tool_call line. Choosing always stores one command_allowlist line for that same which and the same host:port list. A later call skips the question only when a person is present. cron, hermes -q, webhook, msgraph_webhook, and api_server do not send a describe, even after always. yolo and approvals off skip the prompt, and this plugin does not add a refusal for those modes. The plugin does not import Hermes approval, config, or write-guard modules. Hermes 0.21.4 does not list the skill. The v0.21.5 canary and Hermes 0.22.2 add one skill line to every session that loads the plugin, including a surface where the tools are turned off. The status tool is on for every surface, including the gateway, and a guest there can call it and approve it when a person can answer. Turn the wyoming_voice toolset off per surface with hermes tools.

entries.name: x-dashboard
entries.title: X Dashboard
entries.description: Zero-cost ($0.00) X analytics dashboard for Hermes Web and Desktop with profile KPIs, verified-follower & impression goal tracking, post/mention feeds, SVG charts, and CSV/JSON export. Disclosure — Free Mode fetches public profile and post metadata from api.fxtwitter.com / api.vxtwitter.com and r.jina.ai and caches snapshots in <hermes_home>/plugin-data/x-dashboard/; when the xurl CLI is on PATH it runs `xurl auth status` locally to detect your linked handle; optional xAI x_search discovery (enable_x_search=true, billed to your xAI account) and Live X API v2 mode (api.x.com with X_BEARER_TOKEN, or the xurl CLI) run only when explicitly opted in.

entries.name: xchat
entries.description: X Chat gateway platform: talk to Hermes in X's end-to-end encrypted DMs. Hermes runs as the X account you connect: chat with it in your own self-chat ("message yourself"), or give it a separate account and DM that. Messages are decrypted and encrypted locally with X's official Chat XDK, so X only routes ciphertext. Encrypted media, threaded replies, group mention gating and cron delivery.

entries.name: xmemo
entries.description: Native XMemo memory provider for Hermes Agent — durable, identity-aware cross-session memory with semantic search. Disclosure — cloud memory provider: sends each user prompt (for recall and the search tools), model-written memories and mirrored built-in Hermes memory writes, plus a stable install ID, to xmemo.dev (Yonro Co., Ltd.); keeps a local SQLite cache of recalled results and a queue of unsent writes in $HERMES_HOME/xmemo_cache.db, partitioned by a hashed account identity; reads the key from XMEMO_KEY (also MEMORY_OS_API_KEY / MEMORY_OS_MCP_TOKEN) and, if none is set, falls back to the xmemo login token in ~/.config/xmemo/credentials.json (a catalog rule 11 deviation kept for existing users); workflow and destructive tools and timeline capture are off by default and opt-in.

entries.name: yandex-disk
entries.title: Yandex Disk
entries.description: Browse, search, read, write, upload, download, copy, move, share, delete and restore files on Yandex Disk over its REST API. Disclosure — sends every request to cloud-api.yandex.net, or to the https URL in YANDEX_DISK_BASE_URL if you set one, with your YANDEX_DISK_OAUTH_TOKEN read through Hermes; file bytes go to the upload and download hosts the API hands out, without the token; unless YANDEX_DISK_ACTIONS leaves search out, loading the plugin sends one search request to learn whether the token may search, and yadisk_search is registered only if it may; every tool, permanent delete, emptying the bin and public share links included, is offered unless YANDEX_DISK_ACTIONS narrows them (read gives a read-only Disk); yadisk_upload reads a local file and sends it unredacted, and yadisk_download writes one, after Hermes' shared file-safety rules and the plugin's own: upload refuses .env files, Hermes' credential stores, Hermes' own directory and the home directories that hold keys and logins; download refuses credential files, Hermes' own directory, .hermes directories, agent instruction files such as AGENTS.md, system locations and paths outside HERMES_WRITE_SAFE_ROOT; other local files are within reach; YANDEX_DISK_ROOT confines Disk paths, not local ones; an upload from a URL makes Yandex fetch that URL; file names and contents written by other people reach the agent as tool output; no telemetry, no shell access, no background process. Independent community plugin, not affiliated with Yandex.

entries.name: yandex
entries.title: Yandex Search API
entries.description: Yandex Search API as a backend for the built-in web_search (provider name yandex), plus a yandex_generative_search tool for grounded answers with cited sources. Disclosure — sends web_search queries and yandex_generative_search questions to searchapi.api.cloud.yandex.net, or to the base URL in YANDEX_SEARCH_API_URL if you set one, with your YANDEX_API_KEY and YANDEX_FOLDER_ID read through Hermes; the Search API is a paid Yandex Cloud service billed to the folder that owns the key; no other endpoint, no telemetry, no file or shell access, no background process. Independent community plugin, not affiliated with Yandex.

entries.name: yandex_calendar
entries.title: Yandex Calendar
entries.description: List, create, update, RSVP to, move and delete Yandex Calendar events over CalDAV, with attendees, busy status and several calendars. Disclosure — sends every request to caldav.yandex.ru, or to the HTTPS URL in YANDEX_CALENDAR_BASE_URL if you set one, with your YANDEX_CALENDAR_LOGIN and YANDEX_CALENDAR_APP_PASSWORD read through Hermes; all seven tools, delete included, are offered unless YANDEX_CALENDAR_ACTIONS narrows them; the tools act as your Yandex account, so adding attendees makes Yandex email each of them an invitation from you, and changing, answering, moving or deleting a meeting may notify the people on it; delete removes the event from the server and the plugin keeps no copy; event text written by other people, such as whoever invites you, reaches the agent as tool output; no other endpoint, no telemetry, no file or shell access, no background process. Independent community plugin, not affiliated with Yandex.

entries.name: yantrikdb-hermes-dashboard
entries.description: Local-only YantrikDB dashboard for Hermes Agent memory operations

entries.name: yantrikdb
entries.description: Persistent memory for Hermes. Canonicalizes duplicate memories, surfaces contradictions between structured or recognized single-valued claims for review, and returns a why_retrieved reason list with every recall. Embedded by default: no server, no token, no GPU. Optional HTTP backend for HA clusters; pluggable embedders (bundled potion-2M default).

entries.name: yolo-auto
entries.description: Yolo-Auto: flat-rate OpenAI-compatible API with plan-filtered live model discovery.

entries.name: you-should-know
entries.title: You should know
entries.description: A side agent rereads the conversation while Hermes works on longer turns and surfaces the one thing you might have missed — a silent tradeoff, an unverified result, an irreversible action — as a dismissible note above the prompt. Disclosure — on tool-using turns in Desktop, CLI and TUI (configurable via `platforms`), sends up to 12,000 characters of the recent conversation, including clipped tool calls and results, to Hermes's configured auxiliary model up to five extra times per turn (45 s cooldown), which adds model cost; notes are stored in the plugin's own data folder.

entries.name: you
entries.description: You.com skills for live web search, URL content extraction, cited research, finance research, and integration discovery via the You.com MCP servers (api.you.com). Portable Agent Plugins v1 package (mcp.json + skills/, five skills bundled); auth via YDC_API_KEY, OAuth, or MPP/x402 — the free profile works keyless.

entries.name: youtube-dock
entries.title: YouTube Dock
entries.description: Open your signed-in YouTube Home recommendations and Shorts in the existing Hermes Desktop Browser beside your conversation, without pasting video URLs or launching an external browser. Desktop-only SDK launcher; no agent tools, hooks, middleware or API keys. Disclosure — explicit user clicks load YouTube and its normal service/CDN requests in the native Browser; this plugin does not read credentials, cookies, recommendations or watch history. No telemetry, shell commands, backend service or self-updater. Uses the native preview toggle (Hide for an already-open destination), not a dedicated PIP player.

entries.name: zalo-platform
entries.description: Zalo Bot Platform gateway adapter for Hermes Agent — relays messages between Zalo DMs/groups and the agent over the official Bot API (bot-api.zaloplatforms.com), long-polling or webhook mode. Adds slash commands and moderation. Zero extra dependencies (uses httpx, already a Hermes dependency). Production-tested on multiple Vietnamese deployments. Disclosure — connects to the third-party Zalo Bot API (bot-api.zaloplatforms.com) with your bot token; long-polling by default, or opt-in webhook mode with a listener on 127.0.0.1 by default that checks the X-Bot-Api-Secret-Token header; the setup wizard writes ZALO_* values to ~/.hermes/.env; group chat history is stored locally under <HERMES_HOME>/zalo-history.

entries.name: zerosignal
entries.description: ZeroSignal — private, pay-per-request inference through the local zs-proxy; no API key, your wallet is the credential.

entries.name: zoth
entries.description: Zoth Studio tool catalog and ZOTHOS local-service tools (search/open Studio tools, probe Zoth services on 127.0.0.1, pull published tools)

removed.name: or-picker
removed.reason: Folded into openrouter-picker. Installing the provider alone left the picker broken. Install openrouter-picker.
